definitions.explanation: An amount or degree that is neither too much nor too little; just right. Often used when discussing health, exercise, or consumption.

examples.japanese: {適度|てきど}な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Moderate exercise is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {適度|てきど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{適度|てきど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{摂|と}る→摂る：29372_toru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's important to consume salt in moderation.

notes:
USAGE: {適度|てきど} is commonly used with topics related to health, lifestyle, and balance. It suggests an optimal middle ground.

FORMS:
- {適度|てきど}な〜 (moderate ~, appropriate ~) - na-adjective
- {適度|てきど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (moderately, in moderation) - adverbial
- {適度|てきど} (moderation, proper degree) - noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適度|てきど}な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (moderate exercise)
- {適度|てきど}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧ (adequate sleep)
- {適度|てきど}な⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧ (appropriate tension)
- {適度|てきど}な⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (appropriate distance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{程|ほど}よい→程よい：07318_hodoyoi⟧ - just right, moderate (more casual)
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧ - appropriate, suitable (more formal)
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧ - suitable; also 'random/half-hearted' (be careful with context)
